name: Takamine Hina
source:
The eldest daughter of the Takamine family.
She works as a freelance video editor.
She is the more sensible of the sisters, but is easily swayed by her desires.
She has a casual attitude toward her younger sisters, but acts like a big sister to the main character.

"I want a fresh young cock!"
